planets.name: LTT 1445 A b
planets.description: Transiting planet of LTT 1445 A with a 5.36-day year, found in 2019.

text.card: LTT 1445 A b was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LTT 1445 A. Its orbit and size follow Pass et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
